2026 Soybean Discount Schedule (10/01/2026)
#1 Yellow Beans
Discount Rates:
           Test Weight:                                          Less than 54lb        3 cents/bu each lb
                                                                 Subject to rejection below 50 lbs
               Shrink:                                           13.0%-15.0%          1% shrink each 1/2%
                                                                 15.1%-30.0%          1.5% shrink each 1/2%
                                                                 18.0% and above      Call for price
                                                                 Additional 6 cents per bu if 15% or above in Sheldon
                                                                 14% and above subject to rejection
                                                                 15.0% and above will be charged 10 cent drying charge
               Drying:                                           15.5%-16.0%          .120 cents plus .0048 cents /0.1% mo
                                                                 16.1%-19.0%          .168 cents plus .0054 cents /0.1% mo
                                                                 19.1%-30.0%          .324 cents plus .0051 cents / 0.1% mo
                                                                 Stored bushels accrue drying charges starting at 15%
               Foreign Material:                                 0.1% shrink each .1% FM over 1% FM
                                                                 10% and above subject to rejection
               Damage:                                           2.1%-4.0%          3 cents/bu each %
                                                                 4.1% and above     5 cents/bu each %
                                                                 10% and above subject to rejection
               Heat Damage:                                      0.5% and above      5 cents/bu each 1/2%
                                                                 3.0% and above please call for price
               Splits:                                           20% and above        .01 each 1% above 20%
                                                                 35% and above call for price
               Storage:                                          5 cents/bu/month storage
                                                                 4 cents/bu/month Deferred Pricing (price by 07/31/2027)
               Out Charge:                                       14 cents per bushel
               Musty:                                            5 cents (Subject to Rejection)
               Sour:                                             15 cents (Subject to Rejection)
               COFO:                                             20 cents (Subject to Rejection)
               Infested:                                         10 cents (Subject to Rejection)
               Mold:                                             15 cents (Subject to Rejection)
               Stones:                                           12 cents (subject to Rejection)
*River Country Cooperative reserves the right to decline the purchase of any product at its operatives discretion.
*River Country Cooperative reserve the right to take grain in-lieu-of unpaid drying and storage charges.
All grain accounts will be settled before check is issued or before removal of all grain.
